register.name: EMPA (National Producer Register)
register.notes: Producers register in the national producer register held by EOAN and comply via a licensed collective system (HERRCO). HERRCO operates under Law 4819/2021 (ex 2939/2001).

notes: Rates intentionally null: HERRCO's monetary-contribution tables live in Annex C1 of its one-year Participation Contract, approved by the competent authorities but NOT published as a public per-material fee schedule (confirmed 2026-08-16 on herrco.gr/en/businesses). HERRCO is the licensed packaging PRO (Green Dot licensee); members declare via declarations.herrco.gr; 3,936 businesses under contract as of 31.12.2025. Covers paper, plastic, glass, aluminium and tinplate. Separate single-use-plastic environmental levy exists in Greece (not the packaging EPR fee).

drs.note: Sagatavošanā; nacionālā DRS gaidāma ap 2026., vēl nav apstiprināta kā aktīva.
